name: SIGCHI Gary Marsden Travel Awards
amount: Depends on funds available and applications per cycle (complimentary registration codes + reimbursement of flights, lodging, meals, local transport, childcare; visa fees excluded)
duration: One-off per conference (physical travel support max once every 3 years)
eligibility: Students, early-career researchers (up to 5 years post-graduation), or those facing financial hardship / lacking institutional support; must be SIGCHI member when applying; attending SIGCHI-sponsored/in-cooperation conferences
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated; priority to financial need and benefit to applicant, which favours researchers from low-income countries.
how_to_apply_tip: Next deadlines 2026-11-09 then 2027-01-09 (11:59 PM AoE); conference must start more than one month after the deadline. Good fit: HRI (ACM/IEEE Human-Robot Interaction) is SIGCHI-sponsored. Buy SIGCHI (not just ACM) membership before submitting on Submittable.
deadline_quote: There are seven deadlines: the 9th of January, February, March, May, July, September, and November at 11:59 PM AoE
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded in January 2024, so on the 9 Nov 2026 deadline it is about 2 years 10 months old (and still under 5 years at every 2027 deadline). That meets the 'up to 5 years post-graduation' early-career rule, and there is no nationality restriction. You must hold SIGCHI membership when you apply and attend a SIGCHI-sponsored or in-cooperation conference that starts more than one month after the deadline you choose.
eligibility_quote: Targets "early-career researchers (such as those who are ≤ 5 years post-graduation)" and those "experiencing financial hardship or lacking institutional support." "You must be a SIGCHI member at the time of application to be eligible." "For physical travel, you can only receive support once every three years."

name: COMSTECH Research Fellowship Programme (CCoE)
funder: OIC Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation (COMSTECH)
amount: International low-cost return airfare paid by COMSTECH; host institution expected to provide subsistence and supervision
eligibility: Young researchers with MS (age <= 35) or PhD (age <= 45) or active researchers; citizens of or employed in an OIC member state; preference to early-career researchers
eligibility_note: Open to citizens of all OIC member states (Pakistan is a member and COMSTECH host); placement at CCoE member institutions in OIC countries
how_to_apply_tip: Pick a CCoE host outside Pakistan from COMSTECH's list, then email the online form, CV, 2 references and head-of-institution letter to comstech@comstech.org.
deadline_quote: Deadline: Applications /Nominations are open all around the year
verdict_reason: You are a Pakistani (OIC) citizen with a PhD, and the post-PhD track caps age at 45, so ages 36-45 pass. The page sets no limit on years since PhD, so your January 2024 award does not matter, and it sets no institution-type limit. You must apply before you turn 46.
eligibility_quote: Age limit: Maximum 35 years (For graduate studies), 45 years (For post-graduate studies) ... Eligible Countries: All OIC member states. ... They are offered to young scientists holding at least an M.S or equivalent degree for graduate studies, and Ph.D. for post-graduate studies or involved in active research. Eligible applicants for the research fellowships are young scientists and Engineers who are citizens of an OIC country, or are employed by a research institution in an OIC country.

name: Juan de la Cierva 2026 (Ayudas para contratos Juan de la Cierva)
funder: Agencia Estatal de Investigación (AEI), Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades
amount: EUR 35,700 per year towards salary + employer social security, plus EUR 15,000 for research expenses (total call EUR 61.05 million)
eligibility: PhD defended between 1 Jan 2024 and 31 Dec 2026; must join a Spanish R&D centre different from the PhD centre; not applying to Ramón y Cajal 2026; no previous JdC award; any nationality
eligibility_note: Official FAQ: the call is open to all researchers meeting the requirements regardless of nationality.
how_to_apply_tip: Act now: you must fill and sign you form 12-26 Nov 2026 (14:00 Spanish time), and a Spanish university/research centre must then submit by 3 Dec 2026, so secure a host group (e.g. a robotics/AI group at UPC, UPM, UC3M, IRI-CSIC) immediately. CV and historial may be in English.
deadline_quote: "El plazo de presentación de las solicitudes se iniciará el día 12 de noviembre y finalizará el día 3 de diciembre de 2026 a las 14:00 horas (hora peninsular española). Sin perjuicio de lo anterior, el plazo para la cumplimentación y firma por las personas participantes del formulario electrónico de solicitud se iniciará el día 12 de noviembre y finalizará el día 26 de noviembre de 2026 a las 14:00 horas (hora peninsular española)."
verdict_reason: The call counts your PhD date as the day you defended and passed your thesis, not the award date. Your December 2023 defence falls just before the 1 Jan 2024 start of the general-access window, so you are excluded even though the degree was awarded in January 2024. The window can only be extended for career breaks such as illness, parental leave or caring duties, and the profile lists none. The disability track starts its window on 1 Jan 2023 but needs a certified disability of at least 33%.
eligibility_quote: "la fecha de obtención del grado de doctor debe estar comprendida entre el día 1 de enero de 2024 y el 31 de diciembre de 2026. Se entenderá como fecha de obtención del grado de doctor, la fecha del acto de defensa y aprobación de la tesis doctoral." / "La fecha límite inferior de 1 de enero de 2024, establecida en el párrafo anterior, podrá ampliarse cuando entre la fecha de obtención del grado de doctor y la fecha de cierre del plazo para la cumplimentación del formulario de solicitud concurra alguna de las situaciones que se citan a continuación..." / "b) Solicitar la incorporación en un centro de I+D distinto a aquel en el que realizaron su formación predoctoral." / FAQ 10: "La convocatoria está abierta a todos aquellos investigadores e investigadoras que cumplan los requisitos establecidos en la convocatoria, sin menoscabo de su nacionalidad."

name: Bienvenüe+ MSCA-COFUND Postdoctoral Fellowships (Brittany) – 2nd call
funder: Région Bretagne (co-funded by EU HORIZON-MSCA-COFUND and 20 host institutions)
amount: Covers 75-90% of the postdoctoral fellow's salary costs (employment contract at Breton host); euro figure see website
eligibility: Doctorate at call deadline, no limit on years since PhD; must not have worked/resided >12 months in France in last 3 years; projects in Brittany RIS3 priority areas; all disciplines
eligibility_note: Programme targets 'highly-talented international postdoctoral fellows'; only the MSCA COFUND doctorate + France mobility rules are stated; no nationality restriction stated.
how_to_apply_tip: Find a Breton host lab now (e.g. IRISA/Inria Rennes, IMT Atlantique, ENSTA Bretagne, Lab-STICC for AI/robotics) and align the project with a Brittany RIS3 priority; the application template is mandatory and submission is only via the Région Bretagne extranet.
deadline_quote: "The 2026 will open on December the 1st 2026. The call deadline will be on February the 16th 2027 at 12:00 am CET."
verdict_reason: You hold a doctorate (awarded January 2024), the call has no cap on years since PhD, and you have not lived in France, so you meet the only stated rules. No age, nationality, gender or home-institution rule is given. Check whether '12:00 am CET' means midnight at the start of 16 Feb, and submit a day early.
eligibility_quote: "Doctorate: the candidate must possess a doctorate degree at the call deadline. Contrary to the MSCA-Postdoctoral Fellowships, there is no limit of experience after the thesis. Mobility rule: the candidate must have worked or resided less than 12 months in France in the last three years, at the call deadline."

name: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan (Standard)
funder: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
amount: JPY 362,000 per month maintenance allowance + round-trip airfare + JPY 200,000 settling-in allowance + overseas travel insurance; host can apply for KAKENHI research funds
eligibility: Citizen of a country with diplomatic relations with Japan; PhD within 6 years as of 1 April of the fiscal year; host researcher at a KAKENHI-eligible Japanese institution applies on your behalf
eligibility_note: Open to citizens of any country that has diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan has had relations with Japan since 1952). Full-time employment status of the candidate is not considered.
how_to_apply_tip: You cannot apply yourself: find a Japanese host professor (e.g. robotics lab) who submits the application through their institution. Host institutions set internal deadlines often more than a month before 23 April 2027, so contact hosts now.
deadline_quote: [FY2027 schedule table] Recruitment 2nd: Application deadline (from host institution to JSPS) April 23, 2027 (by 5 p.m. (JST)); Periods for arrival in Japan September 1, 2027-November 30, 2027
verdict_reason: You meet both candidate conditions. Pakistan has diplomatic relations with Japan. Your PhD, awarded in January 2024, is about 3 years 3 months old on 1 April 2027 (FY2027), well inside the 6-year window. Your Associate Professor post does not matter because employment status is not considered. No age, gender or home-institution rule applies.
eligibility_quote: (1) Be a citizen of a country that has diplomatic relations with Japan (JSPS treats Taiwanese and Palestinian researchers in this manner). (2) as of April 1 of the fiscal year, have obtained a doctoral degree within six years of the date the fellowship goes into effect ... Whether or not the candidate is employed in a full-time position is not considered.

name: FWF ESPRIT Programme
amount: Full-time senior postdoc salary (FWF rates) + EUR 45,000 lump sum for project costs
eligibility: Postdocs of all disciplines from Austria and abroad; doctorate ≤5 years at submission; ≥2 quality-assured publications; Austrian host institution submits; mentor in Austria
eligibility_note: 'addressed to highly qualified postdocs of all disciplines from Austria and abroad'; no nationality restriction.
how_to_apply_tip: Find a mentor at an Austrian university (e.g. TU Wien, TU Graz, JKU Linz robotics or AI labs). The host institution submits through FWF elane. You must leave or take leave from your current post for the 36 months.
deadline_quote: There are no submission deadlines for this program; applications can be submitted at any time.
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded in January 2024, so it is about 2 years 10 months old now and stays within the 5-year limit at application until January 2029. Your publication record (h-index 18) easily meets the two-publication rule. The permanent-post exclusion applies only to posts at the applying Austrian institution, so your BIC post does not block you, but you must take leave from it for the 36 months.
eligibility_quote: The ESPRIT program is addressed to highly qualified postdocs of all disciplines from Austria and abroad at the beginning of their academic career ... The doctoral degree of principal investigators must have been awarded no more than five years at the time of application ... Persons who at the time of submitting the application already have a position at the applying research institution that includes the prospect of permanent employment ... cannot serve as the principal investigator.

name: DAAD Research Grants in Germany (postdoc stays)
amount: Monthly stipend per DAAD rates + insurance contribution (see call)
eligibility: Postdocs up to 4 years after doctorate; resident in Germany ≤15 months; project at a German university/research institute with supervisor
eligibility_note: Pakistan-specific application deadline published in the DAAD database (origin = Pakistan).
how_to_apply_tip: The Pakistan round closed on 31 Aug 2026. Prepare a host invitation letter for the next round (Pakistani deadlines usually fall at the end of August) and check the database in Q2 2027.
deadline_quote: You can find the current dates here: 31.08.2026 Selection date in February 2027 Start of funding in May 2027 at the earliest
verdict_reason: The limit is 4 years from completing the doctorate to the application deadline. If the next Pakistan deadline falls around end-August 2027, your PhD will be about 3 years 8 months old counting from the December 2023 defence (3 years 7 months from the January 2024 award), so you pass. An August 2028 deadline would fail, which makes the next round your last. You live in Pakistan, which has its own deadline. This is a short 2-6 month postdoc stay, not a long fellowship.
eligibility_quote: Postdocs: You should not have completed your doctorate more than 4 years before the application deadline. ... Your application cannot be considered, if you have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

name: F.R.S.-FNRS Postdoctoral Researcher Fellowship (CR – Chargé·e de recherches)
amount: Full-time fixed-term postdoc employment contract (FNRS scales)
eligibility: PhD ≤5 years at rectors' validation deadline; research at a university of the French-speaking Community of Belgium with a permanently appointed promoter
eligibility_note: Rules and Regulations contain no nationality condition.
how_to_apply_tip: Find a promoter at UCLouvain, ULB, ULiège or UMONS (robotics/AI) now. The call usually opens in December and the applicant validation deadline falls in early January (8 Jan in 2026).
deadline_quote: (2026 call, mini-guide) Opening of the call: WEDNESDAY, 10TH DECEMBER 2025 ... Postdoctoral Researcher CR ... APPLICANT Thursday 8th January at 2 p.m.
verdict_reason: The 5-year limit runs to the rectors' validation deadline of the call. For the 2027 call (early 2027) your PhD, defended December 2023 and awarded January 2024, will be about 3 years old, and it stays within the limit through the 2028 call. The regulations set no nationality, age or home-institution restrictions. You need a permanently appointed promoter at a French-speaking Belgian university. The 2027 call dates are not yet published.
eligibility_quote: Article 4: Applicants to a Postdoctoral Researcher fellowship must have obtained the academic degree as referred to in Article 3 for maximum 5 years. This term shall expire at the latest on the validation deadline set for the academic authorities (rectors) to validate applications. ... Holders of a Postdoctoral Researcher (CR) fellowship shall carry out a Postdoctoral-level research work in a university of the French-speaking Community of Belgium under the supervision of a promoter.

name: KAUST Global Postdoctoral Fellowship
funder: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
amount: USD 75,000 per year living stipend + up to USD 40,000 research funding + housing, medical, schooling, relocation, travel
eligibility: PhD within 4 calendar years (Call 2027: PhD after Jan 2023); all nationalities; research aligned with KAUST missions incl. AI
eligibility_note: 'People of all nationalities are welcome to apply.' Must meet Saudi residency requirements.
how_to_apply_tip: Stage 1 is a short concept note each Sept 1 - Oct 1; prepare it and two referees by August 2027 for Call 2028, and name up to three KAUST AI/robotics faculty.
deadline_quote: Submission of Concept Note is accepted from 1 September to 1 October 2026. ... Full proposals will be accepted from 15 November 2026 to 15 January 2027.
verdict_reason: Your PhD was awarded in January 2024, which meets the Call 2027 rule (PhD after January 2023 inclusive). If the four-calendar-year rule rolls forward as before, Call 2028 would require a PhD after January 2024 inclusive, so you would just qualify and it would be your last chance. All nationalities are accepted and AI is a named mission. You would have to work full-time at KAUST with no other primary employment. Stage 1 of Call 2027 closed on 1 Oct 2026; Call 2028 concept notes are expected September 2027.
eligibility_quote: Must have been awarded a Ph.D. degree, within four calendar years - those applying for CALL 2027, must have received their Ph.D. after January 2023 inclusive; ... People of all nationalities are welcome to apply.

name: RIKEN Special Postdoctoral Researcher (SPDR) Program
amount: JPY 550,000 per month salary + commuting and housing allowances + research budget JPY 1,000,000 per year
eligibility: PhD awarded on or after 1 Jan 2021 (FY2027 call); must find a RIKEN host lab in an eligible lab list; science/engineering fields related to RIKEN research
eligibility_note: FY2027 call lists no nationality restriction; qualifications are PhD date, ability to start in the fiscal year, independent research.
how_to_apply_tip: Agree a topic with a RIKEN lab head (e.g. at RIKEN AIP or a robotics-related centre) by early in the year; registration runs Feb-April and referee letters are due the same day as the application.
deadline_quote: Applications for the FY 2027 Special Postdoctoral Researcher (SPDR) Program have been closed. ... Basic information registration deadline: April 2, 2026 ... The deadline for the letters of reference is the same as the application deadline (April 9).
verdict_reason: Your PhD, awarded in January 2024, satisfies the rule that the PhD be awarded on or after 1 January 2021. The call has no nationality, age or home-institution condition. You would need to take a full-time 3-year RIKEN contract, so you would have to take leave from or resign your BIC post. Watch for the FY2028 call around February 2027.
eligibility_quote: Applicants must fulfill all four conditions given below: 1. Be prepared to independently and responsibly pursue a research topic. 2. Have a PhD awarded on or after January 1, 2021, or expect to be awarded a PhD by the date of hire. 3. Able to start work in FY 2027 (April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2028)

name: AI2050 Early Career Fellowship
amount: Not stated on official page (award supports a three-year project; USD 300,000 figure not confirmed)
eligibility: Postdoctoral and pre-tenure researchers from around the world; nomination only
eligibility_note: Fellows page: aimed at researchers 'from around the world'; closed nomination process, no open application.
how_to_apply_tip: Cannot self-apply: ask your institution or senior collaborators connected to AI2050 to nominate you; build a visible beneficial-AI research agenda.
deadline_quote: AI2050 Early Career Fellows are selected using a closed nomination process, so there is no application.
verdict_reason: Nomination-only; official page targets 'postdoctoral and pre-tenure researchers' and is silent on nationality/institution. Unclear whether an Associate Professor counts as pre-tenure.
eligibility_quote: AI2050 Early Career Fellows are selected using a closed nomination process, so there is no application. ... encourage postdoctoral and pre-tenure researchers from around the world.
ask_funder: Does an untenured Associate Professor at a private transnational college in Pakistan, whose PhD was awarded in January 2024, count as 'pre-tenure' for AI2050 Early Career nomination, and who may nominate?

name: PSF Industrial Solution Grants for Young Scientists
funder: Pakistan Science Foundation (PSF) – R&D Industry Programme
amount: See website
eligibility: Young scientists (PI at a Pakistani institution) proposing applied solutions to industrial problems with MS/MPhil/PhD student engagement and an industry partner
eligibility_note: Domestic PSF call for researchers at Pakistani institutions; official notice not directly retrievable – verified via PSF RGMS guide and university ORIC postings
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a letter of commitment from an industry partner and submit via RGMS; AI for manufacturing/quality control fits well.
deadline_quote: Concept Paper Submission Guide: Industrial Solution Grants for Young Scientists. Deadline: 31st March 2026
verdict_reason: PSF guide only requires a PI at a Pakistani institution plus an MS/PhD student and industry Co-PI; 'young scientist' age/PhD-year limit and accepted institution types are not stated, and BIC does not run MS/PhD programmes.
eligibility_quote: There are three elements for this grant: i) a PI (Principal Investigator) working at a Pakistani Institution, ii) a student of MS/Ph.D, iii) a CoPI from Industry.
ask_funder: How old can you be, or how many years after your PhD, to count as a 'young scientist'? My PhD was awarded in January 2024. Is a private TNE college (BIC) an eligible PI institution? Can the MS/PhD student come from another university? When is the next call?

name: ICLR Financial Assistance
amount: Tiered (2026): registration+hotel (~USD 1,745) or reimbursement up to USD 1,500; hotel only (~USD 1,320) or reimbursement up to USD 1,000; registration only
eligibility: Students and early-career contributors (authors, workshop/tiny-paper authors, reviewers); considers financial hardship, cost of attendance, first ICLR
eligibility_note: No country restriction; priority to contributors from underrepresented demographic and geographic backgrounds.
how_to_apply_tip: ICLR 2027 paper decisions are 16 Dec 2026; watch iclr.cc for the FA form in Jan-Feb 2027 and choose the reimbursement tier if you need airfare.
deadline_quote: ICLR 2026: "March 1st, '26 (AoE)" (closed); ICLR 2027 financial assistance page not yet published (404).
verdict_reason: The aid targets 'student and other early-career contributors' but never defines early-career, so it is unclear whether you qualify as an Associate Professor whose PhD was awarded in January 2024 (about 3 years 3 months before ICLR 2027). There is no country restriction, and underrepresented regions get priority.
eligibility_quote: Aim: "fund student and other early-career contributors"; priority to "student authors," "contributors from underrepresented demographic groups," and "contributors from underrepresented geographic regions."
ask_funder: Does ICLR financial assistance treat a faculty member (Associate Professor) whose PhD was awarded in January 2024 as an 'early-career contributor'?

name: TÜBİTAK 2221 Fellowships for Visiting Scientists and Scientists on Sabbatical Leave
amount: Up to TRY 81,000 per month (visiting scientist) or TRY 105,000 per month (sabbatical), plus health insurance support of up to TRY 560 per month for 3–12 month stays. Round-trip airfare is included.
eligibility: PhD holders working at universities/research institutions abroad; host scientist (full-time, PhD) at a Turkish university or TÜBİTAK centre applies
eligibility_note: TÜBİTAK page states no nationality restriction; aimed at Turkish and other scientists working abroad.
how_to_apply_tip: Four calls a year (next window 2-30 Nov 2026). Register on ARBİS with your passport name; the Turkish host writes the proposal (in Turkish) and submits it.
deadline_quote: 4th term: opens 02 Nov 2026, closes 30 Nov 2026. The system will be closed to applications at 17:30 on the application deadline.
verdict_reason: No nationality restriction is stated, and the Turkish host applies. However, visiting scientists in doctoral-level posts abroad must have at least 4 years of work at a university, research centre or company by the application date. If those years must come after the PhD, you fail: your PhD was awarded in January 2024, which gives only about 2 years 10 months by 30 Nov 2026 and about 3 years 11 months even at the last 2027 call. If your lecturing before the PhD counts, you may pass.
eligibility_quote: Scientists who hold a doctorate and work abroad in a position requiring one must have been working in a university, research center, or private sector for at least 4 years as of the application date. | The host scientist must be a full-time staff member of the host institution in Türkiye and hold at least a doctoral degree.
ask_funder: Does the 4-year work-experience rule for visiting scientists count academic employment before the PhD (for example, as a lecturer), or only years after the doctorate? Does employment at a private TNE college in Pakistan count as a 'university'?

name: Eric and Wendy Schmidt AI in Science Postdoctoral Fellowship (NTU)
amount: Attractive remuneration package (amount not stated) + travel allowances
eligibility: Within 3 years of PhD in a non-computer-science area; research applying AI to engineering, natural sciences or mathematics; NTU project mentor support letter required
eligibility_note: No nationality restriction stated; international initiative.
how_to_apply_tip: Get a support letter from an NTU faculty mentor first (attach it to the proposal); include your Scopus Author ID in the CV.
deadline_quote: Application Process - 2026 Call Submission Deadline: 31 Dec 2026, 2359hr (Singapore Time, UTC/GMT+8).
verdict_reason: If the 3 years run to the 31 Dec 2026 deadline, your January 2024 award puts you about 2 years 11 months past your PhD, which passes. Your December 2023 defence would also pass if you apply before its third anniversary. The page does not give the reference date, so you would fail if it is the fellowship start date in 2027. Electrical Engineering is not computer science, but the scheme targets non-CS scientists who apply AI to their field, and an EE PhD focused on AI may be judged as an AI/CS background.
eligibility_quote: Applicants must be within 3 years of having obtained PhD degree or equivalent degree in non-computer science areas. ... Only research on applying AI techniques to engineering, natural sciences and mathematical sciences will be supported.
ask_funder: Is the 3-year PhD window measured to the 31 Dec 2026 application deadline or to the fellowship start date, and is it counted from the thesis defence (Dec 2023 for me) or the degree award (Jan 2024)? Does a PhD in Electrical Engineering whose thesis used AI methods count as a 'non-computer science' PhD, for a project applying AI to robotics/engineering?

name: CAS President's International Fellowship Initiative (PIFI) – Postdoctoral Researchers
amount: See website
eligibility: Foreign researchers recommended by a CAS host institute; no direct applications
eligibility_note: Official portal states no nationality, age or PhD-year rule and does not list a postdoctoral category on its info page.
how_to_apply_tip: You cannot apply alone: a CAS institute host (e.g. Shenyang Institute of Automation, Institute of Automation) must recommend you. Ask the host whether the postdoc category is currently accepting.
deadline_quote: PIFI is open to applications all year round.
verdict_reason: The official portal says applications are year-round but does not confirm a postdoctoral category or its age/PhD rules, and other sources report the scheme is paused; you need a CAS host to confirm.
eligibility_quote: PIFI is open to applications all year round. (The page gives no age, PhD-year or nationality criteria; per the page, applications come through a CAS host, not directly from foreign researchers.)
ask_funder: Is the PIFI postdoctoral researcher category open for 2027? What are its age and PhD-year limits for a Pakistani applicant aged 36-45 whose PhD was awarded in January 2024?

name: FAPESP Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PD)
amount: Monthly stipend per FAPESP table (fapesp.br/3162) + research overhead + moving allowance
duration: Up to 36 months (renewable to 48 in some grant-linked cases)
eligibility: Doctorate < 7 years; supervisor employed at a São Paulo-state research institution submits via SAGe; exclusive dedication
eligibility_note: Open worldwide; foreign candidates must arrange their own Brazilian visa/residence.
deadline_quote: "Applications may be submitted to FAPESP at any time throughout the year."
how_to_apply_tip: Find a São Paulo supervisor (USP, UNICAMP, UNESP, ITA) with an active FAPESP grant; they submit for you. Also watch fapesp.br/oportunidades for pre-funded PD openings in AI/robotics.
verdict_reason: Your PhD, awarded in January 2024, is well within the under-7-years rule, and your nationality fits. However, the fellowship requires exclusive dedication and bars formal employment, so you could keep your BIC Associate Professor post only if FAPESP accepts a leave of absence.
eligibility_quote: "Candidates for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship must have completed their Doctorate less than 7 (seven) years ago"; "The Fellowship requires exclusive dedication to the research project."; "Throughout the term of their Fellowship, Fellowship Recipients are not allowed to be formal employees"; "At the discretion of FAPESP, situations may be considered in which the candidate is a formal employee and has a leave of absence from the affiliated institution, with or without salary, that allows for exclusive dedication to research."
ask_funder: Would FAPESP accept a PD fellow who holds a permanent Associate Professor post at a private college in Pakistan and takes unpaid leave for the fellowship period?

name: Digital Futures Postdoc Fellows in Technologies for Digital Transformation
funder: Digital Futures (KTH Royal Institute of Technology / Stockholm University / RISE)
amount: SEK 2.4 million toward salary costs for two years
eligibility: Own project with KTH/SU main supervisor + Digital Futures co-supervisor; doctorate awarded before start
eligibility_note: 'We highly welcome international applicants from institutions worldwide.'
how_to_apply_tip: Calls run about twice a year with a pre-registration step 2 weeks before the deadline. Secure letters from a KTH robotics (e.g. RPL) main supervisor and a co-supervisor early.
deadline_quote: Call deadline: 16 October 2026 ... Pre-registration ... no later than two (2) weeks before the full submission deadline.
verdict_reason: International applicants are welcome and robotics and AI are core Digital Futures topics. However, the call text refers to doctorate completion around Jan-Jun 2027, which may target fresh PhDs, and does not state an upper limit on time since PhD.
eligibility_quote: The doctoral degree must be awarded before the postdoc fellowship commences ... We highly welcome international applicants from institutions worldwide.
ask_funder: Is there a maximum time since PhD for the Digital Futures postdoc fellows call (my PhD was awarded in January 2024), and when is the next call expected?

name: GA ČR POSTDOC INDIVIDUAL FELLOWSHIP – Incoming (PIF-IN)
amount: Investigator salary up to CZK 65,000/month + project costs (see website)
eligibility: PhD within last 4 years; long-term foreign experience; no employment at a Czech scientific institution during tender period; full-time single-investigator project at a Czech research organisation
eligibility_note: Scheme aims at 'foreign researchers to arrive to Czechia'; no nationality restriction found in Practical Information.
how_to_apply_tip: Next tender is expected to be announced in February (2026 tender ran 10 Feb - 31 Mar); secure a Czech host (e.g. CTU CIIRC, Brno University of Technology) in advance and prepare the proposal in GRIS.
deadline_quote: "Tender Period: 10 February – 31 March 2026" (2027-funding tender; next tender not yet announced)
verdict_reason: Your PhD date counts from the award. In the 2026 tender, 'no more than 4 years' meant an award on or after 30 Sep 2022, measured at 30 September of the tender year. If the next (2027) tender keeps that rule, the cutoff becomes on or after 30 Sep 2023, and your January 2024 award passes. A 2028 tender would exclude you. You have never worked in Czechia, but the documents do not define how 'long-term foreign experience' applies to a non-Czech researcher, and the next tender's rules are not yet out.
eligibility_quote: "Helping Czech scientists to return from abroad or foreign researchers to arrive to Czechia" / "For researchers up to 4 years after obtaining their Ph.D." / "By 30 September 2026, no more than 4 years have elapsed since the receiving of the Ph.D. (or equivalent) to the Applicant, i.e. award on or after 30 September 2022" / "Long-term foreign experience must be completed and documented no later than 30 September of the year in which the Public Tender is published" / "During the Tender Period, the Applicant must not have an employment or similar relationship at any scientific institution in Czechia"
ask_funder: For a Pakistani national who has always worked outside Czechia, does work in Pakistan count as the required 'long-term foreign experience' for PIF-Incoming? Will the 2027 tender require a PhD award on or after 30 September 2023 (mine was awarded January 2024), and when will it open?

name: Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE) – Postdoctoral component (V2)
funder: Fonds de recherche du Québec (FRQ) / Québec Ministry of Higher Education
amount: CAD 35,000 (one year)
eligibility: Non-Canadian; PhD ≤ 2 years before competition closing; must be PRESELECTED by a Québec university or CCTT network; postdoc at an institution other than PhD-granting one
eligibility_note: V2 component open to candidates from all countries who are not Canadian citizens/PRs.
deadline_quote: 2027-2028 preselection instructions: "Les responsables doivent sauvegarder, valider et transmettre le formulaire au plus tard le 27 octobre 2026 à 16 h (heure du Québec)." (candidate-stage date for 2027-28 not published on FRQ site; 2026-27 candidate deadline was "December 2nd, 2025 at 16:00 (EST)")
how_to_apply_tip: You cannot apply directly: a Québec university's PBEEE liaison must preselect you (2027-28 preselection closed 27 Oct 2026). Contact a host's PBEEE office early in the next cycle (usually summer).
verdict_reason: The postdoctoral component requires the PhD to be at most 2 years old on the competition closing date. Your PhD was awarded in January 2024, so you passed that mark in January 2026. Any closing date for the 2027-2028 competition (preselection already closed 27 Oct 2026) or a later one is more than 2 years after your award and your December 2023 defence.
eligibility_quote: "Ce concours est ouvert à toutes les personnes candidates qui ne détiennent pas la citoyenneté canadienne ou le statut de résident permanent du Canada"; "Les bourses de recherche postdoctorale s'adressent aux chercheuses et chercheurs en formation qui ont obtenu leur doctorat depuis deux ans ou moins à la date de fermeture du concours"; "Seuls les candidats présélectionnés par un établissement universitaire québécois ou le Réseau CCTT peuvent soumettre une candidature."

name: Shuimu Tsinghua Scholar Program
amount: RMB 300,000 per year salary (pre-tax) + campus housing or RMB 42,000/yr housing subsidy + faculty medical plan
eligibility: PhD obtained within last 3 years (or about to obtain); recommended after department interview; full-time at Tsinghua; overseas and domestic PhD forms
eligibility_note: Global recruitment call states no nationality restriction (separate form for overseas PhDs); no age limit in the call itself, but Chinese postdoc rules and departments may apply a 35-year age norm.
how_to_apply_tip: Contact a Tsinghua host (e.g. Automation or EE department) first; the department interviews you and submits the recommendation. Two rounds per year (March and September submissions).
deadline_quote: Second round of applications and reviews: Submission date: September 2026 (please consult the department to which you are applying for the specific time) Recommendations provided by departments: October 10, 2026
verdict_reason: Applicants must have obtained their PhD 'within the last three years'. Your January 2024 award passes three years in January 2027, so by the next round (March 2027 submissions) you are outside the window. The 2026 rounds have closed. The call is also silent on age, while Chinese postdoctoral station rules commonly cap entry at 35.
eligibility_quote: Applicants must fulfill the following requirements: (1) Will obtain their PhD degree, or have obtained their PhD degree within the last three years; (2) Recommended by the interview of the department; (3) Undertake to work full time at Tsinghua University after commencing the program.

name: Start-up Research Grant Program (SRGP) for fresh PhDs
amount: Up to PKR 1,000,000
eligibility: Fresh PhD (within 2 years) joining as an IPFP Fellow at a public university or a private university eligible for public funding; one-time only
eligibility_note: Pakistani faculty only; current HEC/NAHE page frames SRGP for IPFP (Interim Placement of Fresh PhDs) fellows – confirm whether non-IPFP regular faculty can still apply
how_to_apply_tip: You get only one chance and incomplete files are rejected: collect 3 vendor quotations, signed ORIC/VC undertaking and budget sheet before submitting the online form.
deadline_quote: A faculty member on IPFP needs to apply for Start-up Research Grant within 01 months of his/her joining.
verdict_reason: SRGP is only for fresh PhDs who join a public university, or a private one eligible for public funding, as IPFP Fellows. You are an experienced Associate Professor at a private TNE college, not an IPFP fellow. Your PhD, awarded in January 2024, is also past the 2-year 'fresh PhD' window.
eligibility_quote: Fresh Ph.D. degree holder who has recently joined a public sector or private sector university eligible for public funding (first time after Ph.D.) as IPFP Fellow on Interim Placement of Fresh Ph.D. (IPFP). / Experienced faculty members/researcher or Faculty of Private Institutions are not eligible for Government funding

name: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan (Short-term, PE)
funder: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
amount: JPY 362,000 per month (PhD holders) + airfare + JPY 200,000 settling-in allowance (3+ months)
eligibility: Citizens/permanent residents of the US, Canada, EU, UK, Switzerland, Norway or Russia, or 3+ years continuous research in those countries; PhD within 6 years
eligibility_note: Restricted to Europe/North America citizens or researchers based there for 3+ years; Pakistan is not an eligible country.
how_to_apply_tip: Not usable from Pakistan; use the JSPS Standard programme instead.
deadline_quote: FY2027 2nd: January 8, 2027 (by 5 p.m. (JST)); 3rd: June 4, 2027 (by 5 p.m. (JST))
verdict_reason: You are a Pakistani citizen living in Pakistan, and this short-term track is limited to citizens or long-term researchers of the US, Canada, Europe and Russia. The rule does not depend on your PhD date (awarded January 2024, within 6 years).
eligibility_quote: (1) Be a citizen or permanent resident of an eligible country stipulated in the below (*). Also eligible are persons who have been engaged in research continuously over a period of at least three years at a university or research institution in one of the eligible countries. ... (*) Eligible countries are the US, Canada, European Union countries, UK, Switzerland, Norway and Russia.

name: Fulbright Scholar Program (Pakistan) – postdoctoral research / lectureship in the US
amount: Airfare, living stipend, health insurance, research allowance + support for one dependent
eligibility: PhD/terminal degree, all fields except clinical medicine; invitation letter from US university; NOT eligible if PhD earned within last 2 years or in US for research/study in last 5 years
eligibility_note: Pakistani citizens living/working in Pakistan; dual US nationals excluded. Profile note: becomes eligible once PhD is >2 years old
how_to_apply_tip: Start emailing US hosts in summer 2027: an invitation letter must be in the application, along with 3 references.
deadline_quote: Status: Closed — Deadline: October 28, 2026
verdict_reason: The two-year exclusion no longer applies to you. Your PhD was defended in December 2023 and awarded in January 2024, so it was more than 2 years old at the 28 Oct 2026 deadline and will be about 3 years 9 months old at a similar 2027 deadline. You are a Pakistani citizen in Pakistan, and EE/robotics is an eligible field. No institution-type rule applies. You remain eligible only if you have not been in the US for research or long-term study in the last five years, hold no US nationality, and have no spouse, parent or adult child who is a US citizen or permanent resident. You also need an invitation letter from a US university. The 2026 round closed on 28 Oct 2026, so plan for the next cycle.
eligibility_quote: Every applicant must either hold Ph.D. or terminal degree in his/her field. ... Scholars and professionals from all disciplines are welcome to apply, with the exception of clinical medicine. ... Not eligible: Persons who have completed their Ph.D. within the last two years ... who have been to the U.S. for research or other long term educational opportunities within the last five years. Persons with a dual U.S./Pakistan nationality ... who have a spouse, parent or child over 18 year of age who is U.S. citizen or permanent resident. ... you must have at least one invitation letter from the U.S. university

name: IsDB-TWAS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Skills Building in Sustainability Science
amount: Monthly allowance + up to USD 2,600 bench fee + up to USD 1,000 airfare
eligibility: Nationals of 21 least-developed IsDB member countries; age ≤ 45
eligibility_note: Pakistan is not on the 21-country eligible list; programme discontinued.
deadline_quote: "The programme has been discountinued"
how_to_apply_tip: Not available.
verdict_reason: The programme is discontinued and Pakistan is not among the eligible nationalities. Neither reason depends on your PhD date (awarded January 2024).
eligibility_quote: "Early-career researchers from the 21 least developed member countries of the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) are eligible"; eligible nationalities list (Afghanistan, Bangladesh, ... Yemen) omits Pakistan.

name: Sindh HEC International Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme (Phase II)
amount: Living allowance up to USD 1,500/month (PPP-based) + USD 2,000 health insurance + USD 6,000 research/bench fee + PKR 350,000 return airfare
eligibility: HEC-recognized PhD; regular employee of a Sindh public/private HEI; age <= 50; preferably 5 years post-PhD experience in Sindh; placement at QS top-200 (top-500 considered); Digital Innovation is a priority area
eligibility_note: Requires Sindh domicile and PRC (Form C) plus employment at a Sindh HEI
how_to_apply_tip: Arrange the host placement letter first; post the hard copy and email the PDF to ad.qa@sindhhec.gov.pk with all NOCs.
deadline_quote: LAST DATE OF APPLICATION SUBMISSION: 31ST MARCH 2026
verdict_reason: The scheme is limited to regular faculty of universities/DAIs or HEIs in Sindh who hold Sindh domicile and a PRC. BIC is not a university or DAI, and the profile does not list Sindh domicile. The scheme also prefers 5 years of post-PhD experience in Sindh, and your PhD was awarded only in January 2024.
eligibility_quote: Applications are invited from the regular faculty members of Public and Private sector universities/DAIs and professionals of regulatory bodies of HE in Sindh ... Be a regular employee of public/private sector universities/HEIs in Sindh. ... Hold Domicile & Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC- Form C) of the Sindh Province.

name: TÜBİTAK 2232-B International Fellowship for Early Stage Researchers
amount: TRY 2,350,000 initial grant + TRY 150,000/month coordinator scholarship + up to TRY 3,000,000 project grant + team scholarships
eligibility: Under 40 at call opening; PhD within last 4 years with at least 1 year postdoc abroad; plus a top-institution/highly-cited criterion
eligibility_note: Open to all nationalities who meet the experience and age rules.
how_to_apply_tip: Revisit after you complete a 1-year postdoc abroad at a top-150 (QS/THE field) institution, if you are still under 40.
deadline_quote: Application Period 2025: Start Date 27/09/2025, Finish Date 30/12/2025 (17.30 GMT+3)
verdict_reason: Your PhD, awarded in January 2024, is inside the 'last 4 years' window. However, the call requires at least 1 year of postdoctoral research abroad, and you have none because you have worked in Pakistan since your PhD. The age limit is also under 40, while your age band is 36-45.
eligibility_quote: Researchers applying to the programme must be under the age of 40* as of the call opening date. ... Early-stage researchers who, after completing their doctoral degrees within the last 4 years, have at least 1 year of postdoctoral research experience abroad.
